content.value:
Supporting our people financially to be all they can be  


The Te Wānanga o Raukawa Foundation General and A.R.T Scholarships are provided to encourage and support students to undertake higher level studies (Heke and above) at Te Wānanga o Raukawa in 2021.   


Students from any iwi may apply however, preference will be given to members of A.R.T - Te Āti Awa ki Whakarongotai, Ngāti Toa Rangatira and Ngāti Raukawa ki te Tonga. 


Eligibility 

Open to fulltime or part time students studying over 0.5 study load enrolled at heke, poutuarongo, poutāhū and tāhuhu level in 2021, with the exception of: 

  • Te Wānanga o Raukawa staff 
  • Kura and college students 
  • Teacher training students eligible for a TeachNZ study award or scholarship 
  • Te Wānanga o Raukawa students eligible for TEC fees free funding, and; 
  • Students who are in receipt of any other scholarships including Educating the Whānau cohorts
     

All students needing financial assistance to study should apply, applications will be considered on a case by case basis.

 

Value 

Amount to be determined for full-time students.   Students studying over 0.5 part-time receive an amount respective to their study load. 


Closing Date 

31 March 2021. All applicants will be notified of the outcome mid April 2021 and upon confirmation of enrolment. 


Additional Information 

  • This scholarship is a contribution only towards the study fees at Te Wānanga o Raukawa and may not meet all course or fee costs. 


Conditions 

  • The scholarship is conditional on fulfilment of all study requirements of the programme. 
  • Where requirements are not met the recipient may be required to repay the amount of the scholarship to Te Wānanga o Raukawa in 2021. If students are not progressing satisfactorily the second instalment may not be paid. 
  • Non completion in previous years – if reapplying, the academic record for previous years will be checked and preference given to students with a sound academic history. 
  • Scholarships may not be available for students receiving major scholarships ($3,000 or more). Applicants are to declare in their application if they have or may apply for other scholarships in 2021. 

 Payment Advice 

Payments will be applied to the 2021 fees in two instalments (mid year and end of year). More information about payments will be provided in the applicants’ success letter. 

Apply Online 

Before completing the application ensure you have read and understand eligibility and criteria information. The following information is required when completing the application: 

  • Iwi and hapū details 
  • Contact details 
  • Name of the programme/qualification you are enrolled in 
  • Bank account details (payable only where fees have already been paid)

 The online application will be opening soon - please check back shortly.

Te Wānanga o Raukawa Foundation 

For more information on the Te Wānanga o Raukawa Foundation visit  www.tworfoundation.co.nz . 

Kia rangatira te tū a Te Wānanga o Raukawa, hei whare ako whakatupu hoki i te mātauranga.
